details: It's probably a crazy idea and it will probably sounds like something "egoistic", but I'll try. So, as we know VRChat depends a lot from world creators, because without worlds to explore people wouldn't play the game and a lot of world creators do this to help the growth of VRChat and well, even for themselves. With VRChat Plus people can support VRChat devs, but for what I've seen so far a lot of people as much as they love the game they are not stimulated to pay for just an image in their nametag and more avatar favourites because well, the game it's still an early access and there's still a lot of problems to the game (at least, that's what I heard a lot as the reason why they don't want to have VRChat Plus). But what if us, world creators, have the possibility to add more function to our worlds if the player have VRChat Plus? A good example it will be like exclusive avatars that appear only if the player have a VRChat Plus subscription, or maybe some exclusive weapons in a game world. But why a world creator would do that? I mean, yeah, they're paying VRChat devs, but the world creator doesn't receive anything, so it will be more likely that no one would add such a thing in their world. But what if they are rewarded for doing that? One of the ideas would be, like they do on youtube, to have a promotion code in their world, and if someone use that promo code a tiny percentage would go to the world creator while subscribing to VRChat Plus, or another idea would be based on the activity of the world, if someone interact with the exclusive things in the world, after a certain number you can receive a free VRChat Plus subcription for a month, but I'm guessing this would be hard to implement. In any case with a system like this everyone would win, VRChat will receive more subscriptions, people can support their favorite world creators and world creators will have something in return for helping VRChat to grow and they actually have a good reason to do that, while increasing even the overall quality of the worlds to appeal people to support them. Hopefully it's not too crazy, in my mind it feels like a good idea lol
title: VRChat Plus for world creation
